# TutorGuard - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it — in plain text for AI agents and answer engines.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: TutorGuard
- Tagline: Keep every AI tutor reply safe before students see it.
- Domain: https://tutorguard.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does
- TutorGuard automatically reviews your AI tutor's replies for unsafe content, factual errors, and policy violations, intercepting anything risky before it reaches a student.
- Review tutor arrangements for safety red flags
- Get a vetting and interview checklist
- Spot quality and fairness warning signs
- Receive a parent safety action plan

## Pricing (USD)
- **Free** — $0 — 1 tutor vetting check / day · watermarked report
- **Family** — $9/mo — Continuous monitoring of tutors · quality reports · CSV/JSON export
- **Enterprise** — Custom — Tutoring agencies · SSO · BYOK · shared rulesets
- Checkout: https://tutorguard.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://tutorguard.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)
